Variant of: Arasaka Nowaki
Cost: 125eb (Premium)
Class: Exotic Poor Quality Assault Rifle
Range: Battle Rifle
Pre-installed: Battle Barrel (effects already included in these stats)

Ironfake variant: an Exotic, Poor Quality bootleg of the listed original. Every BODY requirement of the original goes up by 1. Can't be bought through the Edgerunners Mission Kit option of paying double to skip the Fixer. Unless stated here, it keeps the original's rules.

No Autofire. Every shot fires a 3-round burst, and armor ablation increases by 1 SP.

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).
  • Exotic weapon.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog > Variants).
